proofs.text: Run init and verify `.purlin/hooks/pre-push` names `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` and is executable, `.git/hooks/pre-push` names `.purlin/hooks/pre-push` and is executable, and neither `.purlin/hooks/pre-commit` nor `.git/hooks/pre-commit` exists; delete the shim, run the delegator and verify exit 0 with `no hook shim` on stdout; verify `scripts/hooks/` carries neither a pre-commit script nor a separate gate script

rule_text: init writes the tracked shim `.purlin/hooks/pre-push` and the delegator git runs, both executable, the delegator reaching the shim and saying so rather than failing when the shim is absent; no pre-commit hook is installed and the plugin ships no pre-commit script

tests.body:
def test_no_pre_commit_hook_is_installed(self, project):
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        assert not project.has('.purlin/hooks/pre-commit')
        assert not project.has('.git/hooks/pre-commit')
tests.name: test_no_pre_commit_hook_is_installed

tests.body:
def test_the_shim_and_the_delegator_are_written(self, project):
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        shim = read(project.path('.purlin/hooks/pre-push'))
        assert 'scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh' in shim
        assert os.access(project.path('.purlin/hooks/pre-push'), os.X_OK)
        delegator = read(project.path('.git/hooks/pre-push'))
        assert '.purlin/hooks/pre-push' in delegator
tests.name: test_the_shim_and_the_delegator_are_written

def test_no_pre_commit_script_ships(self):
        assert not os.path.exists(
            os.path.join(ROOT, 'scripts', 'hooks', 'pre-commit.sh'))
        assert not os.path.exists(
            os.path.join(ROOT, 'scripts', 'hooks', 'pre_push_gate.py'))
tests.name: test_no_pre_commit_script_ships

def test_the_delegator_git_runs_reaches_the_shim(self, passing):
        delegator = read(passing.path('.git/hooks/pre-push'))
        assert '.purlin/hooks/pre-push' in delegator
        assert os.access(passing.path('.git/hooks/pre-push'), os.X_OK)
tests.name: test_the_delegator_git_runs_reaches_the_shim

tests.body:
def test_the_delegator_survives_a_checkout_without_the_shim(self, passing):
        os.remove(passing.path('.purlin/hooks/pre-push'))
        done = subprocess.run([SH, passing.path('.git/hooks/pre-push')],
                              cwd=passing.root, capture_output=True,
                              text=True, timeout=300,
                              stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert done.returncode == 0
        assert 'no hook shim' in done.stdout
tests.name: test_the_delegator_survives_a_checkout_without_the_shim
